target_window.rationale: C4-T2 multi-year validation protocol binds 80% statistical power at observed episode rate 0.012355 episodes/day; 283-day spec window is 2.78x too short (0.33% power). This v2 request encodes the executed C4-T2 requirement, not prose.

requirements.provenance: Hyperliquid-native only (documented API source, extraction method, extraction time, no synthetic generation)
requirements.archive_format: Parquet or CSV per symbol with columns: timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume
requirements.source_documentation: SOURCES.md sidecar inside archive directory recording origin, extraction method, extraction timestamp, any transformations

acceptance_predicates.archive_exists: archive directory/file exists on disk at declared path
acceptance_predicates.provenance_documented: SOURCES.md sidecar present with Hyperliquid-native origin, extraction method, timestamp
acceptance_predicates.full_window_coverage: every required symbol has >= 24319 hourly bars covering 2023-12-20T17:19:21Z .. 2026-09-28T23:00:00Z inclusive
acceptance_predicates.min_crash_days_met: >= 10 distinct calendar days with RSI(21)<20 crash events across universe
acceptance_predicates.per_file_sha256_recorded: SHA256 for each symbol file recorded in provenance manifest
acceptance_predicates.volume_gate_satisfied: all symbols pass trailing 24h >= $5M at decision points

machine_checkable_commands.step3_verify_provenance: PYTHONPATH=. /tmp/crs-venv/bin/python -c "import json,sys; p='research_state/cache/hyperliquid_1h_full_20231220_20260928/provenance.json'; m=json.load(open(p)); ok=m.get('summary',{}).get('all_complete') is True and m.get('summary',{}).get('ready_for_real_campaign') is True and m.get('fabricated_data') is not True; print('all_complete=',m.get('summary',{}).get('all_complete')); print('ready_for_real_campaign=',m.get('summary',{}).get('ready_for_real_campaign')); print('fabricated_data=',m.get('fabricated_data')); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

pass_fail_rules.step5: exit 0; output states 'REAL run complete: ...'; script refuses incomplete/unverified/synthetic inputs (non-zero)

critical_statement: The 283-day spec window (2025-12-20..2026-09-28) provides only 0.33% probability of achieving >=10 independent crash episodes (C3-T3 power sensitivity). The multi-year window (1,013.2 days) is the binding 80%-power requirement — 283 days is 2.78x too short. No session may relabel the 283-day partial run or OKX cross-venue data as Hyperliquid performance evidence.
